title: A document-only diff under a document-only intent respects the scope limit
text:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -1 +1 @@
-Teh tool reads a diff.
+The tool reads a diff.
intent: READMEの誤字を修正する。コードは変更しない。
rationale: The limit is stated and kept: only a document changes. A stated limit alone must not produce a finding.
